song.title: Fire of God
song.lyrics:
[V1] Verse: Light the coal fan the flame Passion for Your holy name
[C1] Chorus: Fire of God consume our souls No matter where we are or were we go Fire of God consume our souls tonight
[B1] Bridge: I just wanna burn with a love so pure A passion for Your name with Your flame in my soul I just wanna burn with a love so pure tonight
song.author: Corey Voss
